traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Sphenocleaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary half inferior or inferior; floral cup absent; joined corolla campanulate or urceolate; stems herbaceous; flowers in spikes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
